problem_statement: A full-thread device must be able to manage the challenge values used in MLE link-request exchanges through a shared, bounded table that tracks one challenge per router ID plus a separate multicast challenge that matches any router ID. The table must support generating a challenge for a given router, generating a multicast challenge, looking up whether a received challenge matches a stored one for a router, aging entries out over a timeout, overwriting an existing router's entry (which resets that entry's timer) when the table is full, and clearing all entries. Without this capability the link-request/response challenge verification cannot be validated against stored, aging entries as the new unit test exercises.
